description_en: Modifies the forwarding mode of an Elastic IP Address (EIP)
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-eip-forward-mode --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id eip-j5ebhbw3br92fy0000 --biz-mode BINDED --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyEipForwardMode

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the EIP. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: EIP所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the EIP instance to modify
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The binding mode. Valid values:

NAT (default): NAT mode (standard mode).

MULTI_BINDED: multi-EIP to ENI mode.

BINDED: EIP to ENI mode.


This parameter is required only when InstanceType is set to NetworkInterface
parameters.help_zh:
绑定模式，取值：

NAT（默认值）：NAT模式（普通模式）。

MULTI_BINDED：多EIP网卡可见模式。

BINDED：EIP网卡可见模式。


仅InstanceType配置为NetworkInterface时，才需要配置该参数
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
